title: Adopt Material 3 theme
description: Switch the base theme to Theme.Material3.DayNight and map the 21 custom gradients to M3 color roles.
why: Gives consistent, modern components and proper day/night handling for free.

title: Dynamic color (Monet) option
description: Offer a 'System (Material You)' theme using DynamicColors.applyToActivitiesIfAvailable on Android 12+.
why: Matches the user's wallpaper palette, like Droid-ify and Neo Store do.

title: Follow system dark/light mode
description: Add an 'Auto' theme that follows UI_MODE_NIGHT instead of always-dark gradients.
why: Respects the system setting and reduces eye strain in daylight.

title: Replace ProgressDialog with M3 progress indicators
description: Swap the deprecated ProgressDialog for an inline LinearProgressIndicator or a modal bottom sheet.
why: ProgressDialog has been deprecated since API 26 and blocks the whole UI.

title: Use MaterialAlertDialogBuilder everywhere
description: Replace AlertDialog.Builder with MaterialAlertDialogBuilder so dialogs pick up the theme.
why: Today's dialogs look out of place next to the gradient UI.

title: Bottom navigation bar for top-level screens
description: Turn Home, Settings, Experiments and About into a NavigationBar instead of hidden icons.
why: Makes navigation discoverable; the gear and flask icons are easy to miss.

title: Split screens into Fragments (single Activity + nav graph)
description: Move each visibility-toggled ScrollView (main, settings, about, experiments) into its own Fragment hosted by one Activity with a Navigation graph.
why: Gives proper back-stack, state saving, deep links and testable screens.

title: Edge-to-edge and window insets
description: Call EdgeToEdge.enable() and apply WindowInsets padding, which target SDK 35 enforces.
why: On Android 15 with targetSdk 35 content draws under the status and navigation bars.

title: Predictive back gesture
description: Use OnBackPressedDispatcher and set android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true".
why: The custom _onBackPressed override breaks Android 14+ predictive back.

title: AndroidX SplashScreen API
description: Replace SplashActivity's 1-second Timer with core-splashscreen and keep-on-screen conditions.
why: Android 12+ shows a system splash anyway, so users currently see two splashes.

title: Fix biased splash tagline selection
description: Pick the splash title with a single Random.nextInt(n) instead of re-rolling getRandom in each else-branch.
why: Bug: the chain skews the distribution heavily toward the first entries (TEST_REPORT bug #9).

title: Search/filter in version lists
description: Add a SearchView to filter long version lists by version number.
why: The lists grow with every release and scrolling is tedious.

title: Highlight latest and installed versions
description: Show 'Latest' and 'Installed' chips on list rows by comparing with PackageManager.getPackageInfo.
why: Users mostly want to know whether they're up to date, which Obtainium shows prominently.

title: Pull-to-refresh feedback
description: Show a Snackbar with the result (updated, no changes or error) when the swipe refresh finishes.
why: Refreshing currently ends silently, even on failure.

title: Empty and error states
description: Show a dedicated empty or error view with a Retry button when the API can't be loaded.
why: With an unreachable or empty API URL the main screen just stays blank.

title: Skeleton/shimmer loading placeholders
description: Show placeholder rows while the API JSON loads.
why: Makes the startup wait feel shorter and look intentional.

title: Consistent spacing and typography scale
description: Replace hard-coded textSize and padding values with M3 type and dimen resources.
why: There are hundreds of magic numbers in main.xml, so the visual rhythm is inconsistent.

title: Landscape and tablet layouts
description: Provide sw600dp and land layouts with a two-pane list and details view.
why: On tablets and Chromebooks the phone layout stretches awkwardly.

title: Replace custom RippleReveal with MaterialContainerTransform
description: Use the platform/M3 transitions instead of the hand-written RippleReveal view.
why: Means less custom code to maintain, and it respects reduced-motion settings.

title: App shortcuts
description: Add static and dynamic launcher shortcuts for 'Check for updates' and 'Settings'.
why: Gives quick access for power users without opening the full UI.

title: Themed (monochrome) launcher icon
description: Add a <monochrome> layer to the adaptive icon for Android 13 themed icons.
why: The icon otherwise looks out of place on themed home screens.

title: Explain empty 'LATEST: N/A'
description: When no data has loaded, show 'Couldn't load versions – tap to retry' instead of N/A next to LATEST.
why: N/A reads like 'not available for your device' rather than a load failure.

title: Label the Settings and Experiments switches
description: Give list_auto_refresh_switch, disable_notification_switch, hide_stock_patched_switch, hide_amoled_patched_switch and cloned_version_switch an accessible name: android:labelFor on the sibling TextView, or a contentDescription.
why: The UI dump shows all five Switch widgets unlabelled, so TalkBack reads 'Switch, off' with no context. The icon buttons were already fixed in b29202e (TEST_REPORT row 17).

title: Minimum 48dp touch targets (14 ATF failures)
description: Raise to 48dp with minWidth/minHeight or padding: box_experiment, box_switch, box_update, box_settings_icon_close (32x32dp); box_uninstall, box_settings, box_cache, box_open (32dp high); the 4 settings switches (47x20dp); box_reboot and box_reset_preferences (34dp high).
why: Espresso AccessibilityChecks reports 14 TouchTargetSizeCheck errors (TEST_REPORT rows 19–20).

title: Color contrast audit across 21 themes
description: Check text/background contrast for each gradient theme against WCAG AA (4.5:1).
why: Several bright gradients put white text on light green or yellow.

title: Support font scaling
description: Use sp everywhere, remove fixed heights on text containers and test at 200% font scale.
why: Large font settings currently clip text in fixed-height boxes.

title: Respect reduced motion
description: Skip RippleReveal and the splash animations when ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE is 0 or remove-animations is on.
why: Animations can cause discomfort for vestibular-sensitive users.

title: Accessibility headings
description: Mark section titles with accessibilityHeading=true.
why: Lets screen-reader users jump between sections.

title: Logical focus order
description: Set nextFocusDown/Forward and use importantForAccessibility to hide decorative views.
why: The visibility-toggled screens leave hidden views focusable.

title: Keyboard / D-pad navigation
description: Make all actions reachable with keyboard and D-pad, with visible focus states.
why: Needed for Chromebook, Android TV and switch-access users.

title: Announce state changes
description: Use announceForAccessibility or live regions for 'Refreshing', 'Update available' and errors.
why: Snackbar and toast-only feedback is often missed by TalkBack users.

title: Toggle state semantics for switches
description: Use SwitchMaterial with proper labels instead of clickable LinearLayouts with custom images.
why: TalkBack can't tell whether the custom toggles are on or off.

title: Gate CI on AccessibilityChecks
description: Run the new AccessibilityChecksTest in the emulator CI job, with a suppression list for known issues that shrinks as they're fixed.
why: The ATF checks exist now (helper/tests) but only report; they should block regressions.

title: Don't encode meaning in color alone
description: Add icons or text alongside color for status (latest, outdated, error).
why: Color-blind users can't otherwise tell states apart.

title: Readable changelog formatting
description: Render changelogs as bullet lists with proper semantics instead of a single long TextView.
why: Long unstructured text is hard to navigate with a screen reader.

title: Avoid all-caps text for long labels
description: Remove textAllCaps on long labels; screen readers can spell out all-caps text letter by letter.
why: Improves readability and screen-reader pronunciation.

title: Sufficient timeout for transient messages
description: Use Snackbars with actions and longer durations instead of 2-second toasts for important info.
why: Users with cognitive or motor impairments need more time.

title: Test with Switch Access and Voice Access
description: Add a manual accessibility checklist to the release process.
why: Automated checks don't catch everything.

title: Don't hide content behind long-press only
description: Make every long-press action also reachable via a visible menu.
why: Long press is hard to discover and hard for motor-impaired users.

title: Large-screen pointer and hover support
description: Add hover states and right-click context menus for mouse users on ChromeOS and DeX.
why: Better desktop-mode usability.

title: Label clickable container main_box_1
description: Give main_box_1 a contentDescription, or make it non-clickable if it's decorative.
why: The UI dump shows a clickable 968x61px view with no text or description (TEST_REPORT row 18).

title: Replace java.util.Timer with coroutines/Handler
description: Swap the dozens of Timer and TimerTask uses for Handler.postDelayed or lifecycle-aware coroutines.
why: Each Timer creates a thread, and the tasks aren't cancelled on destroy, which leaks the Activity.

title: RecyclerView instead of ListView
description: Migrate the version and changelog lists to RecyclerView with ListAdapter and DiffUtil.
why: Gives efficient updates and animations and avoids full rebinds on refresh.

title: Continue flattening main.xml with ConstraintLayout
description: Build on b0e6e74's flattening: convert the remaining nested LinearLayout rows of the 2,000+ line main.xml to ConstraintLayout or merge tags.
why: Deep nesting still dominates measure/layout time at startup.

title: Lazy-inflate secondary screens
description: Use ViewStub or separate fragments so Settings, About and Experiments aren't inflated at startup.
why: The whole UI is inflated up-front even though most of it is hidden.

title: Avoid re-serializing JSON in _Backbone
description: Parse the API once into typed POJOs instead of toJson/fromJson round trips per list.
why: Saves CPU and allocations on every refresh.

title: Baseline Profiles
description: Add a baseline profile module to precompile startup paths.
why: Typically gives a 20–30% faster cold start.

title: Enable R8 full mode and resource shrinking
description: Turn on minifyEnabled and shrinkResources for release with keep rules for Gson models.
why: Smaller APK and faster code.

title: Cache API response with ETag/If-Modified-Since
description: Use OkHttp's disk cache and conditional requests.
why: Avoids downloading the same JSON on every launch and pull-to-refresh.

title: Debounce refresh
description: Ignore refresh requests made within N seconds of the last successful fetch.
why: Prevents hammering the API server.

title: Move work off the main thread
description: Make sure the Gson parse, file IO (cache clearing) and PackageManager queries run on background dispatchers.
why: Prevents jank and ANRs on low-end devices.

title: Avoid GradientDrawable allocation per theme switch
description: Define gradients as XML drawables or cache them instead of allocating new ones on every _Theme_UI call.
why: _Theme_UI allocates dozens of drawables each time it runs.

title: StrictMode in debug builds
description: Enable StrictMode thread and VM policies in debug to surface disk and network on the main thread.
why: Finds hidden performance bugs early.

title: Make the logcat reader opt-in
description: Start xManagerLogger only when the user enables 'Debug logging' in Settings, and stop it when they turn it off.
why: Reading logcat continuously wastes CPU and battery, and collecting logs by default is a privacy concern.

title: Image loading with Coil/Glide
description: Load remote images (supporter avatars and the like) via Coil with memory and disk caching, if they're used.
why: Prevents decoding full-size bitmaps on the UI thread.

title: Macrobenchmark startup test
description: Add a Macrobenchmark module measuring cold start and time to the first list render.
why: Puts numbers on performance changes.

title: Remove unused resources and libraries
description: Run lint UnusedResources and drop unused drawables and fonts.
why: Smaller APK and faster builds.

title: Use ViewBinding
description: Replace the hundreds of findViewById calls with ViewBinding.
why: Faster to write, null-safe, and slightly faster at runtime.

title: Reduce overdraw
description: Remove the redundant backgrounds stacked by the gradients plus the window background.
why: Profile GPU overdraw shows 3–4x on the main screen.

title: Startup tracing
description: Add androidx.tracing sections around onCreate, inflate, theme and language apply, and the first fetch.
why: Pinpoints what makes cold start slow in Perfetto.

title: Guard theme spinner re-entrancy
description: In select_theme.onItemSelected, return early when the position equals the current theme (or use a 'programmatic change' flag) before calling _Theme_UI, which calls setSelection.
why: Bug: this recursion produces a StackOverflowError under Robolectric. It's latent on device because the framework only fires on a real change (TEST_REPORT bug #4).

title: Semantic version comparison
description: Replace Double.parseDouble(version) with a proper semver comparator.
why: 5.10 is treated as older than 5.9, which wrongly triggers the maintenance screen, and '5.9.1' crashes the parse (TEST_REPORT #2).

title: Handle HTTP error status codes
description: Treat non-2xx responses as errors in RequestNetworkController instead of passing the body to onResponse.
why: Bug: a 503 HTML error page is fed to Gson and throws JsonSyntaxException (TEST_REPORT bug #6, MockWebServer test).

title: Guard JSON parsing
description: Wrap fromJson in try/catch, validate the required keys and show an error state on malformed data.
why: A broken API response currently crashes the app via the global handler.

title: Null-safe map access
description: Use getOrDefault and type checks for every API key (Telegram, Discord, *_Latest, ...).
why: A missing key causes a NullPointerException with .toString().

title: Configurable/non-empty API URL
description: Ship a real default api_url (or a first-run 'choose source' screen) and show an explicit error when it's empty.
why: Bug: api_url is empty in res/values/api.xml, so every list shows N/A with no explanation (TEST_REPORT bug #7, emulator row 3).

title: Report onErrorResponse to the user
description: Show an error message and Retry instead of the no-op onErrorResponse.
why: Offline users get no feedback at all.

title: Fix sortListMap numeric comparator
description: Return 1 when a > b (currently `a<b?-1:a<b?1:0`), or use Integer.compare.
why: Violates the Comparator contract, so large lists sort incorrectly (TEST_REPORT #1).

title: Parse numeric strings robustly
description: Accept '3.0' (Gson doubles) in numeric sorts and version codes by parsing via Double/Long or BigDecimal.
why: Bug: Integer.valueOf throws NumberFormatException on Gson-produced numbers (TEST_REPORT bug #5).

title: Fix duplicate 'German' language entry
description: Remove the second 'German' from the language list and use stable language codes instead of indexes.
why: Bug: the duplicate shifts indexes and can select the wrong translation (TEST_REPORT bug #3).

title: Restartable, injectable logger
description: Reset isRunning in finally, allow stop/start, don't throw if already running, and make the logger an injectable instance instead of a static singleton.
why: Bug: a second Application.onCreate throws 'Logger already running' (TEST_REPORT bug #8).

title: Cancel timers in onDestroy
description: Keep references to TimerTasks and cancel them in onDestroy/onStop.
why: Late callbacks can touch views of a destroyed Activity and crash.

title: Survive configuration changes
description: Move state (current screen, fetched data) into a ViewModel and SavedStateHandle.
why: Rotation re-runs network calls and resets to the home screen.

title: Request timeouts and retries
description: Set connect/read timeouts and exponential-backoff retry for idempotent GETs.
why: The defaults can hang for a long time on flaky networks.

title: Network availability check
description: Check ConnectivityManager before fetching and show an offline banner.
why: Gives a clear message instead of a generic failure.

title: Crash handler should not loop
description: Make sure DebugActivity can't itself crash into the handler again, and add a 'restart app' action.
why: Avoids crash loops that require clearing data.

title: Export crash report
description: Let users share and copy the DebugActivity stack trace plus device info.
why: Makes bug reports actionable.

title: Stop deleting hard-coded /storage/emulated/0 paths
description: Use getExternalCacheDir()/cacheDir instead of literal paths when clearing the cache.
why: Hard-coded paths break on secondary users and work profiles and are blocked by scoped storage.

title: Handle ActivityNotFoundException for links
description: Fall back to the default browser, and then a 'copy link' option, when Custom Tabs or a browser isn't available.
why: Devices without Chrome or any browser currently crash or do nothing.

title: Validate links before opening
description: Only open https URLs from allow-listed hosts; reject intent://, file:// and content:// schemes coming from the API.
why: Protects against a tampered API response launching arbitrary intents.

title: Idempotent initialization flag
description: Replace the INITIALIZATION and REFETCH SharedPreferences dance with one well-defined first-run state.
why: The interplay of flags is fragile and hard to reason about.

title: Defensive PackageManager calls
description: Catch NameNotFoundException when querying the installed version of a managed app.
why: Gives graceful 'not installed' display instead of crashes.

title: Filter package broadcasts by package name
description: In packageChangeReceiver, read intent.getData().getSchemeSpecificPart() and refresh only for the two managed packages.
why: Today every app install, update or uninstall on the device triggers a PackageManager refresh.

title: Coalesce bursts of package broadcasts
description: Debounce _Refresh_Installed (e.g. 300 ms) so ADDED+REPLACED+CHANGED from one install only refresh once.
why: A single update sends 3–4 broadcasts, each queuing a refresh.

title: Don't touch views after destroy in installed refresh
description: Check isFinishing()/isDestroyed() before posting results from installedExecutor to the UI thread.
why: shutdownNow() interrupts the work but a result already posted can still run against a destroyed Activity.

title: Background update check with WorkManager
description: Schedule a periodic WorkManager job that checks the API and notifies about new versions.
why: Users learn about updates without opening the app, the core feature of Obtainium.

title: Configurable check interval
description: Let users choose the background check frequency (6h, 12h, daily, weekly or off).
why: Balances freshness against battery use.

title: Respect battery saver and Doze
description: Use WorkManager constraints (battery not low, network connected).
why: Better battery citizenship.

title: Release channels
description: Let users choose stable or beta channels for manager updates.
why: Testers get early builds while normal users stay on stable.

title: Ignore/skip a specific version
description: Let users skip a particular update so they aren't nagged about it again.
why: A standard feature in Obtainium and Neo Store.

title: Show changelog in the update dialog
description: Render App_Changelogs in the update dialog with markdown formatting.
why: Users want to know what changed before updating.

title: Last checked timestamp
description: Show 'Last checked: 5 min ago' on the main screen.
why: Gives users confidence that the data is fresh.

title: Maintenance screen with details
description: Show the server-provided message and an ETA, plus a retry button, instead of a static maintenance view.
why: The current screen is a dead end.

title: Offline mode with cached data
description: Show the last fetched lists when offline, clearly labelled as cached.
why: The app stays useful without a network connection.

title: API schema versioning
description: Add a schema_version field to the API and handle unknown or newer schemas gracefully.
why: Lets the backend evolve without breaking old clients.

title: Update check on app start toggle
description: Add a setting to skip the automatic fetch on launch.
why: Some users prefer manual refresh only.

title: Rate-limit aware GitHub API usage
description: Cache GitHub API responses and honor the X-RateLimit headers.
why: Unauthenticated users have only 60 requests an hour.

title: Signed update manifest
description: Sign the API JSON (e.g. with minisign/Ed25519) and verify it on the client.
why: Prevents a hijacked API host from pushing malicious links.

title: Update badge on launcher icon
description: Show a notification-dot/badge count of available updates.
why: A low-friction hint without heads-up notifications.

title: Migrate to a PreferenceFragmentCompat screen
description: Rebuild Settings with AndroidX Preference instead of hand-made rows.
why: Gives standard look, accessibility and much less code.

title: Consolidate SharedPreferences files
description: Merge the 9 separate SharedPreferences files (THEME, LANGUAGE, ...) into one prefs file or DataStore.
why: This simplifies backup, migration and testing.

title: Jetpack DataStore
description: Move settings to Preferences DataStore with typed keys.
why: Asynchronous and type-safe, with no main-thread disk IO.

title: Export/import settings
description: Export settings to JSON through the Storage Access Framework and import them back.
why: Users can restore their setup on a new device.

title: Configure backup rules
description: Replace bare allowBackup=true with dataExtractionRules/fullBackupContent so only the settings prefs are backed up (to cloud and on device transfer), and exclude logs and cache.
why: Today everything, including logs, is in adb/cloud backups; scoped rules still let a new phone restore the theme and language.

title: Reset to defaults
description: Add a 'Reset all settings' action with confirmation.
why: Lets users recover from a bad state without clearing app data.

title: Store theme/language as stable keys
description: Persist language codes ('de') and theme ids instead of display strings or indexes.
why: Index-based storage breaks when lists change (see the duplicate German entry).

title: Settings search
description: Make settings searchable once the list grows.
why: Helps users find options quickly.

title: Explain each experimental option
description: Add summaries and warnings to the Experiments switches.
why: Users don't know what the experiments do.

title: Version switch A/B clarity
description: Rename the SWITCH_VERSION 'A'/'B' options to descriptive labels.
why: The meaning of 'A' and 'B' is opaque.

title: Per-app language via AppCompat
description: Use AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales and locales_config.xml.
why: Integrates with the Android 13 per-app language settings.

title: Settings migration framework
description: Version the settings schema and migrate old keys on upgrade.
why: Lets settings be refactored without losing user preferences.

title: Clear cache confirmation and size
description: Show how much cache will be freed, and confirm before clearing.
why: Makes the action transparent.

title: About screen: open-source licenses
description: Add an OSS licenses screen (e.g. AboutLibraries).
why: Required for attribution, and good practice.

title: Proper notification channels
description: Replace the channel id 'id 1', named and described 'Null' at IMPORTANCE_HIGH, with named channels: Updates, Errors.
why: The channel shows up as 'Null' in system notification settings.

title: POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission
description: Request POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+ with an explanation.
why: Notifications silently fail on Android 13+ without it.

title: Lower default importance
description: Use IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT or LOW for update notifications instead of HIGH.
why: Heads-up notifications for updates are intrusive.

title: Notification grouping
description: Group multiple update notifications into one summary.
why: Avoids flooding the notification shade.

title: Respect DISABLE_NOTIFICATION via channels
description: Map the in-app toggle to channel settings, or deep-link to system channel settings.
why: There is one source of truth for notification preferences.

title: Monochrome small icon
description: Provide a proper white-on-transparent small notification icon.
why: Colored icons render as white squares.

title: FLAG_IMMUTABLE for future PendingIntents
description: When notification actions are added, create every PendingIntent with FLAG_IMMUTABLE (and add a lint check for it).
why: Without the flag, PendingIntent creation crashes on Android 12+. There are no PendingIntents yet, so this is preventive.

title: Quiet hours
description: Don't post update notifications during user-defined quiet hours.
why: Respects users' time.

title: Notification for maintenance/server status
description: Optionally notify when the server comes back from maintenance.
why: Users don't have to keep checking manually.

title: Test notifications in instrumented tests
description: Assert channel creation and notification content in androidTest.
why: Prevents a regression of the 'Null' channel.

title: Notification permission rationale screen
description: Show an in-app explainer before the system POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompt, with a 'Not now' option.
why: Raises the grant rate and respects users who decline.

title: Snooze update reminders
description: Add a 'Remind me tomorrow' notification action.
why: Less nagging, and the user stays in control.

title: Move numbered translations into values-<locale>/ folders
description: 1f992e5 moved the text into res/values/strings.xml as ~80 index-suffixed copies per key (e.g. *_23). Move each language into values-xx/strings.xml under the same key, and delete the if/else chain in _Language_UI.
why: Enables the system locale and per-app language, and shrinks _Language_UI from thousands of setText calls to nothing.

title: Crowdsourced translations via Weblate/Crowdin
description: Set up Weblate (free for FOSS) with the string resources.
why: Lets the community translate without touching Java code.

title: Follow system locale by default
description: Default to the system language instead of English when the user hasn't chosen one.
why: Users get their own language out of the box.

title: Enable RTL support
description: d968c0e switched to start/end attributes but left supportsRtl="false": enable it, mirror the directional icons and test Arabic/Hebrew/Persian.
why: RTL languages are in the language list but render LTR.

title: Plurals and formatted strings
description: Use plurals and placeholders instead of string concatenation.
why: Concatenation produces grammatically wrong text in many languages.

title: Localized dates and numbers
description: Format dates and sizes with DateFormat and Formatter.formatShortFileSize.
why: Locale-correct formatting.

title: Language names in their own language
description: Show 'Deutsch' and '日本語' with the English name as subtitle.
why: Users looking for their own language recognize it immediately.

title: Pseudo-locale testing
description: Enable pseudoLocalesEnabled in debug and test en-XA and ar-XB.
why: Catches truncation and hard-coded strings.

title: Lint for hard-coded text
description: Make HardcodedText and SetTextI18n lint errors fatal on new code.
why: Prevents regressions after the migration.

title: Translation completeness report in CI
description: A CI step that reports missing keys per locale.
why: Gives visibility for translators.

title: Localized changelogs from API
description: Support optional per-locale changelog fields in the API schema.
why: Non-English users can read the release notes.

title: Translator credits
description: Show translators in About, sourced from Weblate.
why: Recognising contributors encourages more of them.

title: Remove locale-specific fonts hacks
description: Use font fallback instead of per-language font switching, if present.
why: Simpler and correct for CJK and Indic scripts.

title: Locale-aware sorting of language list
description: Sort languages with Collator for the current locale instead of a hard-coded order.
why: Makes the list easier to scan in every language.

title: Translatable splash taglines
description: Move the random splash titles to string-array resources per locale.
why: The splash text is currently English-only.

title: Lint check that every language has every key
description: Once locales are in values-xx/, enable MissingTranslation as an error for the supported locales.
why: The index-suffixed scheme can silently miss a language's copy of a key.

title: Remove requestLegacyExternalStorage
description: Drop the legacy storage flag and storage permissions, and use app-specific dirs and SAF.
why: It's ignored on targetSdk 30+ and is a privacy red flag.

title: Minimize permissions
description: Audit the manifest permissions and remove the unused ones.
why: Fewer permissions mean more user trust and less attack surface.

title: Certificate pinning for the API host (optional)
description: Pin the API host's public key via network_security_config, with backup pins.
why: Mitigates MITM on hostile networks.

title: Don't log sensitive data
description: Make sure xManagerLogger doesn't record URLs with tokens or personal data, and cap the log size.
why: Logcat captures can leak data into shared bug reports.

title: Dependency vulnerability scanning
description: Run osv-scanner or OWASP dependency-check against the resolved Gradle dependencies in CI.
why: Catches known-vulnerable library versions (version bumps themselves are covered by Dependabot/Renovate).

title: Secret scanning and no keys in repo
description: Make sure no keystore, API key or token is committed, and add gitleaks to CI.
why: Protects the fork's signing identity.

title: Reproducible release builds
description: Pin dependency versions with Gradle verification metadata, and document the build environment.
why: Lets F-Droid and users verify that the binaries match the source.

title: Publish the signing certificate fingerprint
description: Document the release cert SHA-256 in README and Releases.
why: Users can verify they have the genuine build (AppVerifier).

title: Privacy policy
description: Add a privacy policy describing network calls, the logs collected and no tracking.
why: Builds trust, and is needed for some stores.

title: No analytics / tracker-free badge
description: Check that there are no trackers (Exodus scan) and advertise it.
why: This matters to the target audience.

title: Clipboard hygiene
description: Mark copied links or logs containing device info as sensitive (ClipDescription EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE).
why: Avoids clipboard previews leaking data on Android 13+.

title: Remove package visibility over-reach
description: Only query the packages the app actually needs (keep the <queries> list minimal).
why: Fits Android 11+ package visibility expectations.

title: Integrity check of the manager's own APK at runtime (informational)
description: Show the manager's own signing cert fingerprint in About so users can compare it with the published value.
why: Helps users spot repackaged or malicious copies of the manager.

title: HTTPS-only enforcement for API overrides
description: Reject http:// custom source URLs in Settings.
why: Keeps the cleartext-traffic protections when multiple sources are added.

title: Break up the 9,677-line MainActivity
description: Split it into feature classes: ThemeManager, LanguageManager, ApiRepository, VersionListAdapter and screen fragments.
why: The god-class makes every change risky and untestable.

title: Introduce MVVM with ViewModel + Repository
description: Add a MainViewModel exposing UI state from an ApiRepository.
why: Separates logic from views, survives configuration changes, and is unit-testable.

title: Typed API models
description: Replace HashMap<String,Object> with data classes (ApiManifest, BuildEntry, Changelog).
why: Gives compile-time safety and removes casts and toString calls.

title: Data-driven themes
description: Replace the 21-branch if/else _Theme_UI with a table of Theme(id, colors) and a single apply method.
why: Turns ~1,000 lines of duplication into ~50.

title: Data-driven languages
description: Replace the nested if/else language selection with a map from locale code to resources.
why: This gets rid of a huge source of bugs, such as the duplicate German entry.

title: Remove Sketchware boilerplate
description: Delete the unused SketchwareUtil and FileUtil methods, and the getRandom duplicates.
why: Less dead code to maintain.

title: Consistent naming conventions
description: Rename _Theme_UI, box_switch and main_box_16 to descriptive camelCase names.
why: Makes the code readable for new contributors.

title: Kotlin migration (incremental)
description: Add Kotlin, and write new classes in Kotlin with coroutines.
why: A modern, concise language with null safety.

title: Replace custom RequestNetwork with Retrofit/OkHttp
description: Use OkHttp directly, or Retrofit with converters, instead of the Sketchware wrapper.
why: Gives a standard, well-tested, cancellable API.

title: Dependency injection (Hilt or manual)
description: Provide the repository, OkHttp and prefs via DI.
why: Makes testing and swapping implementations easy.

title: Static analysis: Android Lint baseline
description: Create a lint baseline, fix the high-severity issues and fail CI on new ones.
why: Stops the codebase quality from regressing further.

title: Error Prone / SpotBugs
description: Add Error Prone or SpotBugs to catch null and comparator bugs at compile time.
why: Would have caught the sortListMap comparator bug.

title: Formatter (google-java-format / spotless)
description: Add Spotless with a consistent format and a check in CI.
why: No more style churn in PRs.

title: Version catalog (libs.versions.toml)
description: Centralize dependency versions in a Gradle version catalog.
why: Makes upgrades easy and works well with Renovate.

title: Gradle Kotlin DSL
description: Convert the build scripts to build.gradle.kts.
why: Gives type-safe build config and IDE completion.

title: Constants for preference keys
description: Replace string literals like "THEME" with constants.
why: Prevents typos across thousands of lines.

title: Remove duplicated click handlers
description: Factor the near-identical OnClickListeners for each version list into one helper.
why: Fewer copy-paste bugs.

title: Package structure
description: Organize into ui/, data/, domain/, util/ packages.
why: Makes the codebase easier to navigate.

title: Remove unused imports and warnings
description: Clean up the compiler warnings (deprecations, raw types).
why: Real problems get lost in the noise.

title: Document architecture decisions (ADRs)
description: Add docs/adr/ explaining the major refactor choices.
why: Helps future maintainers understand the code.

title: CI: lint and upload SARIF
description: Run lint and upload SARIF to GitHub code scanning.
why: Findings show up inline in PRs.

title: Release workflow with signing
description: Tag-triggered workflow that builds a signed release APK using encrypted secrets and attaches it to the GitHub Release.
why: Gives repeatable, auditable releases.

title: Gradle build cache and config cache
description: Enable org.gradle.caching and configuration-cache.
why: Faster local and CI builds.

title: Gradle wrapper validation
description: Add gradle/actions/wrapper-validation to CI.
why: Protects against a malicious gradle-wrapper.jar.

title: Dependabot / Renovate
description: Automate dependency and Action version bump PRs.
why: Keeps the toolchain current, which this revive branch shows is needed.

title: Build variants: debug applicationIdSuffix
description: Add .debug applicationIdSuffix and a version name suffix so debug and release can coexist.
why: Developers can test without uninstalling their release build.

title: Upgrade to latest AGP/Gradle
description: Track AGP 8.x/9 and Gradle 8.x/9 updates, and the compileSdk 36 readiness.
why: Stays compatible with new Android Studio releases.

title: Java 17 toolchain declaration
description: Use java { toolchain { languageVersion = 17 } } so builds don't depend on the host JDK.
why: Gives reproducible builds across machines.

title: Version code from git
description: Derive versionCode and versionName from git tags.
why: No more manual bumps or mismatches.

title: APK size report in CI
description: Post the APK size diff on PRs.
why: Catches bloat early.

title: F-Droid metadata
description: Add fastlane/metadata (descriptions, screenshots) for F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid.
why: Helps distribution through trusted channels, if eligible.

title: Build reproducibility check
description: A CI job that builds twice and diffs the APKs.
why: Proves the build is deterministic.

title: Test result publishing
description: Publish JUnit XML results as a PR check (dorny/test-reporter).
why: Shows failing tests directly in the PR UI.

title: Pre-commit hooks
description: Add an optional pre-commit hook running spotless and unit tests.
why: Faster feedback for contributors.

title: Pin GitHub Actions by SHA
description: Reference actions by commit SHA.
why: Guards against supply-chain attacks on tags.

title: Matrix build for minSdk device
description: Add an API 21/23 emulator job to the matrix.
why: minSdk is 21, but nothing tests those versions.

title: Universal + per-ABI release outputs
description: Confirm the app is pure-Java and ship one universal APK, documenting this in the release notes.
why: Avoids user confusion over which APK to download.

title: Make emulator CI ANR-resistant
description: Disable animations, use the -no-snapshot plus hardware-accel runner, raise the dispatch timeout, and wrap launch in IdlingResources rather than sleeps.
why: On the slow emulator the instrumentation aborted with keyDispatchingTimedOut (TEST_REPORT row 21).

title: Screenshot tests (Roborazzi/Paparazzi)
description: Capture screenshots for each of the 21 themes and key languages.
why: Catches visual regressions in the theme refactor.

title: Theme matrix test
description: Parameterized test that applies every theme and asserts no crash plus contrast thresholds.
why: 21 themes are too many to check by hand.

title: Language matrix test
description: Parameterized test that switches every language and asserts that no view keeps the English default.
why: Catches missing translations.

title: Fake API server for instrumented tests
description: Read api_url from BuildConfig or an injectable config so androidTest can point it at MockWebServer.
why: Makes the populated lists, update dialog and maintenance screen testable end-to-end. Today the lists are empty on the emulator.

title: Version comparison tests
description: Exhaustive tests for the new semver comparator.
why: Prevents the 5.10 < 5.9 bug from returning.

title: Rotation/process-death tests
description: Use ActivityScenario.recreate() to check state is restored.
why: Catches lost state and leaks.

title: Monkey / stress test in CI
description: Run adb shell monkey with a fixed seed for N events on the emulator.
why: Finds random crash paths cheaply.

title: Code coverage with JaCoCo/Kover
description: Generate coverage reports and track them in CI.
why: Shows where tests are missing.

title: Leak detection (LeakCanary) in debug
description: Add LeakCanary to debug builds and run it during the UI tests.
why: The Timer-based code likely leaks Activities.

title: Test orchestrator
description: Use AndroidX Test Orchestrator with clearPackageData.
why: Isolates tests from each other's state.

title: Known-bug tests tracked separately
description: Keep @Ignore'd tests referencing each bug so that fixing a bug means un-ignoring its test.
why: Turns bug reports into executable specs.

title: Manual QA checklist
description: A docs/QA.md release checklist (install, upgrade, themes, languages, offline).
why: Covers what automation doesn't.

title: Merge the helper/tests suite into revive/build-fix
description: Bring the 51 JVM tests, Robolectric config, SmokeTest, AccessibilityChecksTest and the CI workflow from helper/tests into the main branch.
why: The tests are written and pass except for the intentional bug characterizations; they only help once they're on the main branch.

title: Update README for the revived fork
description: Explain the fork's status, the differences from the archived upstream, and the build instructions.
why: Users and contributors need to know this is the maintained fork.

title: BUILDING.md
description: Document the JDK 17, SDK and Gradle setup, the test commands and the emulator setup.
why: Lowers the barrier for new contributors.

title: Enable GitHub Issues and Discussions on the fork
description: Upstream has issues disabled; turn them on with templates.
why: Users need a place to report bugs.

title: Pull request template
description: Add a PR template with a testing checklist.
why: Improves PR quality.

title: CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog)
description: Maintain a human-readable changelog per release.
why: Users and packagers can see what changed.

title: SECURITY.md
description: Add a responsible disclosure policy and contact.
why: This is the standard way to receive security reports.

title: Architecture overview doc
description: Describe the screens, data flow, API schema and preference keys.
why: The Sketchware-generated code is very hard to understand without one.

title: API schema documentation
description: Document every JSON key the app reads, with types and examples (JSON Schema).
why: Lets mirror operators and the backend evolve safely.

title: Screenshots and demo GIF
description: Add current screenshots to README and the store metadata.
why: First impressions matter.

title: FAQ in-repo
description: Move the FAQ link content into docs/FAQ.md, versioned with the code.
why: Keeps the FAQ available if external hosts go down.

title: Contributor guide refresh
description: Update CONTRIBUTING.md with the branch model, code style and test expectations.
why: The existing guide references the archived upstream workflow.

title: Good-first-issue labels
description: Seed issues from this backlog with S-effort items labelled good-first-issue.
why: Attracts new contributors.

title: Translation guide
description: Explain how to add or update a translation once strings are in resources and Weblate.
why: Translators aren't developers.

title: Release process doc
description: A step-by-step release checklist: version bump, tag, CI, notes, cert fingerprint.
why: Releases become consistent and auditable.

title: Code of conduct enforcement contacts
description: Update CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md with the current maintainer contacts.
why: The current contacts point to the archived team.

title: Credit upstream and other forks
description: Credit the Team-xManager authors and notable forks in README.
why: Good open-source etiquette, and required by the license terms.

title: Roadmap
description: Publish a ROADMAP.md derived from this backlog's P0/P1 items.
why: Sets expectations for the community.

title: Feature comparison with similar apps
description: Document how xManager relates to Obtainium, Droid-ify and others for inspiration and scope.
why: Clarifies the scope and avoids reinventing features.

title: In-app 'Report a bug' link
description: Add an About-screen link to the fork's issue tracker, pre-filled with the app version and device.
why: Gives better bug reports with less back-and-forth.

title: Document testing without KVM
description: Note in BUILDING.md how to run the emulator with -accel off, hide_error_dialogs and the click-through tools when hardware acceleration is unavailable.
why: Contributors in containers and cloud VMs often lack KVM.
